mapper.insert: INSERT INTO top_up (account_id, amount, money, trade_no, payment_method, payment_provider, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{amount}, #{money}, #{tradeNo}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentProvider}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, amount, money, trade_no, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_trade_no, status, create_time, complete_time FROM top_up WHERE trade_no = #{tradeNo}
SELECT id, account_id, amount, money, trade_no, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_trade_no, status, create_time, complete_time FROM top_up WHERE trade_no = #{tradeNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE top_up SET status = #{status}, provider_trade_no = #{providerTradeNo}, complete_time = NOW() WHERE trade_no = #{tradeNo} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, amount, money, trade_no, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_trade_no, status, create_time FROM top_up WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, account_id, amount, money, trade_no, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_trade_no, status, create_time, complete_time FROM top_up ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
